description: Zero-shot transfer test: UMN-trained pipeline (unmodified, no fine-tuning) run on https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/aj1714/crowd-panic-dataset. Rank-order comparison only -- AUROC deliberately not computed, see module docstring. Short clips are front-padded (frozen first frame) rather than excluded -- see module docstring.

panic_vs_pooled_nonpanic.test_description: Mann-Whitney U, one-sided (panic > pooled non-panic), on per-clip mean k=0 risk scores.
